reply.thought: I need to process the payouts for the customers associated with the refunded orders. First, I must identify which customers are involved in these orders by listing the orders. Then I will calculate the net balance for each unique customer and record the payout.

result.error: bad arguments: World.list_orders() got an unexpected keyword argument 'order_ids'

reply.thought: The list_orders tool does not accept order_ids as an argument. I need to call list_orders() without arguments to get all orders and then filter for the relevant ones (231, 234, 235) to identify the customers.

I have identified the customers associated with the refunded orders: 'birch' (orders 231, 234) and 'cobalt' (order 235). Now I need to get the net balance for each of these customers to determine the payout amount.
I have the net balance for 'birch'. Now I need to get the net balance for 'cobalt'.
I have the net balances for both customers involved in the refunds. Now I need to record the payout for 'birch' first.
The payout for 'birch' has been recorded. Now I need to record the payout for 'cobalt'.
Both payouts have been successfully recorded. I can now finish the task and provide the final report.
